assertions: Completeness assessments are derived artifacts and do not rewrite utterances.
Unknown is preserved when bounded observable signals do not support a classification.
Disfluency spans retain canonical transcript word and interval addressing.
Self-repair candidates separate reparandum, marker, and repair words.
Semantic inference and clinical diagnosis are prohibited by policy.
Analysis persistence is deterministic, sealed, reloadable, and cache-safe.
Cross-utterance word ownership is rejected during validation.
CLI operations expose inspection and review lists without mutating source evidence.
limitations: Rules qualify deterministic mechanics, not linguistic classification accuracy.
Grammatical and discourse completeness are not inferred in this slice.
Disfluency and self-repair records require review and are not diagnoses.
